title: decision
description: A decision record (BRIEF Appendix A, 6.6): the question, the options, the answer, who decided, and what the record carries for a decision ticket or for a question of the grill's design tree. Every entry of research/DECISIONS.md is one, open (answer null) until it is settled.

id.description: a question of the grill's design tree; a record for a decision ticket carries ticket instead

requires.description: the questions whose answers this one waits on; a tier asks it only once they are settled

tier.description: the grill tier that first asked it; null until a tier does

supersedes.description: the settled question this record answers again

decided_by.description: conductor on a decision ticket the conductor closed: the ask of decision 15 superseded, or answered at its timeout

model.description: the model the decider's session ran on (decision 15); absent on an answer no model gave

fallback_from.description: fable when the decider ran on Opus while Fable's weekly window was spent (decision 15)

session_id.description: the decider's session, so its answer can be read back in full; absent on an answer no session gave
